Elasticsearch.description: Configures the connection to the Elasticsearch server, as well as the index prefix, analyzers and token filters. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Elasticsearch/.

ConnectionType.description: The connection pool type. 'CloudConnectionPool' requires 'CloudId'; the other types connect to 'Url' on each of the 'Ports'.

Url.description: The server URL, without the port, e.g. 'http://localhost'. The connection is only considered configured when this is a valid absolute URL.

CloudId.description: The Elasticsearch cloud service id. Only used with the 'CloudConnectionPool' connection type.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication type: 'Basic' uses 'Username' and 'Password', 'ApiKey' uses 'ApiKey', 'Base64ApiKey' uses 'Base64ApiKey', and 'KeyIdAndKey' uses 'KeyId' and 'Key'.

Username.description: The user name used by the 'Basic' authentication type.

Password.description: The password used by the 'Basic' authentication type.

ApiKey.description: The API key used by the 'ApiKey' authentication type.

Base64ApiKey.description: The Base64 encoded API key used by the 'Base64ApiKey' authentication type.

KeyId.description: The key id used by the 'KeyIdAndKey' authentication type.

Key.description: The key used by the 'KeyIdAndKey' authentication type.

CertificateFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the server certificate. Not needed with the 'CloudConnectionPool' connection type.

EnableDebugMode.description: Whether the debug mode is enabled, logging the requests and responses at the 'Debug' level.

IndexPrefix.description: A prefix added to the name of all indexes.

Analyzers.description: The built-in or custom analyzers that can be selected for an index, keyed by analyzer name, e.g. '"standard": { "type": "standard" }'. Defaults to the 'standard' analyzer.

TokenFilters.description: The custom token filters that can be used by the custom analyzers, keyed by token filter name, e.g. '"english_stop": { "type": "stop", "stopwords": "_english_" }'.

OrchardCore_Elasticsearch.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Elasticsearch' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Search:Elasticsearch' instead.
